prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I was telling a coworker about that quick sightseeing day in Xi'an—honestly the food and the old city vibe were the best part.
And earlier that same year I’d been chatting about a train run from Beijing to Shanghai—someone else handled the details, I just showed up and followed along.
Shanghai itself was a whole thing too—when we talked hotels, it was all about staying in Shanghai proper so we could walk around at night.
For that Xi'an day, Cao Yun had already gotten tickets for the Bell Tower, set for 2025-03-20.
I remember it was the afternoon slot, and it was for 3 people—felt like the perfect time because the light was nicer by then.
That Beijing-to-Shanghai ride was on train G1 on 2025-03-02, and the ticket was under Zhang Wei.
He’d picked Second Class, and separately my friend Sophia Garcia had stayed at the Waldorf Astoria Shanghai on the Bund—checked in 2025-05-27 for 5 nights, which sounded wildly fancy.
